mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, asset_type AS assetType, asset_id AS assetId, version_no AS versionNo, source_version AS sourceVersion, content_hash AS contentHash, content_snapshot AS contentSnapshot, status, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, published_by AS publishedBy, published_at AS publishedAt FROM test_asset_version WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND asset_type = #{assetType} AND asset_id = #{assetId} AND content_hash = #{contentHash} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) FROM test_asset_version WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND asset_type = #{assetType} AND asset_id = #{assetId}

SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, asset_type AS assetType, asset_id AS assetId, version_no AS versionNo, source_version AS sourceVersion, content_hash AS contentHash, content_snapshot AS contentSnapshot, status, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, published_by AS publishedBy, published_at AS publishedAt FROM test_asset_version WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND asset_type = #{assetType} AND asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, asset_type AS assetType, asset_id AS assetId, version_no AS versionNo, source_version AS sourceVersion, content_hash AS contentHash, content_snapshot AS contentSnapshot, status, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, published_by AS publishedBy, published_at AS publishedAt FROM test_asset_version WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND asset_type = #{assetType} AND asset_id = #{assetId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, project_id AS projectId, asset_type AS assetType, asset_id AS assetId, version_no AS versionNo, source_version AS sourceVersion, content_hash AS contentHash, content_snapshot AS contentSnapshot, status, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, published_by AS publishedBy, published_at AS publishedAt FROM test_asset_version WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_asset_version SET status = 'DEPRECATED' WHERE id = #{id} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND asset_type = #{assetType} AND asset_id = #{assetId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'

choose.when: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(f.ref_id,''),f.id) AS id,f.project_id,'CASE' AS asset_type,f.name, COALESCE(f.case_edit_type,'STEP') AS category,COALESCE(f.review_status,'DRAFT') AS status, CAST(f.tags AS CHAR) AS summary,COALESCE(f.update_user,f.create_user) AS owner, COALESCE(f.update_time,f.create_time) AS update_time,CAST(COALESCE(f.update_time,f.create_time) AS CHAR) AS source_version,NULL AS related_id FROM functional_case f WHERE f.project_id=#{projectId} AND f.latest=1 AND f.deleted=0

SELECT d.id,d.project_id,'DOCUMENT' AS asset_type,d.original_name AS name,d.mime_type AS category,d.parse_status AS status, LEFT(d.summary,2000) AS summary,d.create_user AS owner,d.update_time,d.sha256 AS source_version,d.file_id AS related_id FROM ai_source_document d WHERE d.project_id=#{projectId} AND d.deleted=0

SELECT p.id,p.project_id,'PLAN' AS asset_type,p.name,p.type AS category,p.status,p.description AS summary, COALESCE(p.update_user,p.create_user) AS owner,COALESCE(p.update_time,p.create_time) AS update_time, CAST(COALESCE(p.update_time,p.create_time) AS CHAR) AS source_version,NULL AS related_id FROM test_plan p WHERE p.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.type='testPlan'

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(f.ref_id, ''), f.id) AS id, f.project_id, 'DATASET' AS asset_type, f.name, COALESCE(f.type, 'FILE') AS category, CASE WHEN f.enable = 0 THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END AS status, f.description AS summary, COALESCE(f.update_user, f.create_user) AS owner, COALESCE(f.update_time, f.create_time) AS update_time, f.file_version AS source_version, NULL AS related_id FROM file_metadata f WHERE f.project_id = #{projectId} AND f.latest = 1 AND UPPER(COALESCE(f.type, '')) IN ('CSV', 'JSON', 'XLS', 'XLSX')

SELECT e.id, e.project_id, 'ENVIRONMENT' AS asset_type, e.name, CASE WHEN e.mock = 1 THEN 'MOCK' ELSE 'TEST' END AS category, 'ACTIVE' AS status, e.description AS summary, COALESCE(e.update_user, e.create_user) AS owner, COALESCE(e.update_time, e.create_time) AS update_time, CAST(COALESCE(e.update_time, e.create_time) AS CHAR) AS source_version, NULL AS related_id FROM environment e WHERE e.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT c.id, c.project_id, 'COMMON_STEP' AS asset_type, c.name, COALESCE(c.type, 'SCRIPT') AS category, COALESCE(c.status, 'DRAFT') AS status, c.description AS summary, COALESCE(c.update_user, c.create_user) AS owner, COALESCE(c.update_time, c.create_time) AS update_time, CAST(COALESCE(c.update_time, c.create_time) AS CHAR) AS source_version, NULL AS related_id FROM custom_function c WHERE c.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.ref_id, ''), a.id) AS id, a.project_id, 'API_DEFINITION' AS asset_type, a.name, CONCAT(COALESCE(a.protocol, ''), '/', COALESCE(a.method, '')) AS category, COALESCE(a.status, 'ACTIVE') AS status, CONCAT(COALESCE(a.method, ''), ' ', COALESCE(a.path, '')) AS summary, COALESCE(a.update_user, a.create_user) AS owner, COALESCE(a.update_time, a.create_time) AS update_time, a.version_id AS source_version, NULL AS related_id FROM api_definition a WHERE a.project_id = #{projectId} AND a.latest = 1 AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT ar.id, t.project_id, 'EVIDENCE' AS asset_type, ar.file_name AS name, ar.purpose AS category, ar.status, CONCAT('task=', ar.task_id, '; sha256=', COALESCE(ar.sha256, '')) AS summary, ar.create_user AS owner, ar.create_time AS update_time, ar.sha256 AS source_version, ar.task_id AS related_id FROM ai_execution_artifact ar JOIN ai_execution_task t ON t.id = ar.task_id WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT b.id, b.project_id, 'BUG' AS asset_type, b.title AS name, COALESCE(b.platform, 'LOCAL') AS category, b.status, CONCAT('BUG-', COALESCE(b.num, '')) AS summary, COALESCE(b.update_user, b.create_user) AS owner, COALESCE(b.update_time, b.create_time) AS update_time, CAST(COALESCE(b.update_time, b.create_time) AS CHAR) AS source_version, NULL AS related_id FROM bug b WHERE b.project_id = #{projectId} AND b.deleted = 0

mapper.select:
SELECT catalog.id, catalog.project_id AS projectId, catalog.asset_type AS assetType, catalog.name, catalog.category, catalog.status, catalog.summary, catalog.owner, catalog.update_time AS updateTime, catalog.source_version AS sourceVersion, catalog.related_id AS relatedId, v.id AS assetVersionId, v.version_no AS assetVersionNo, v.content_hash AS contentHash, COALESCE(m.creation_source,'UNKNOWN') AS creationSource,m.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName,c.path AS categoryPath,m.source_reference_type AS sourceReferenceType, m.source_reference_id AS sourceReferenceId FROM () catalog LEFT JOIN test_asset_version v ON v.id = ( SELECT iv.id FROM test_asset_version iv WHERE iv.project_id = catalog.project_id AND iv.asset_type = catalog.asset_type AND iv.asset_id = catalog.id AND iv.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY iv.version_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN test_asset_metadata m ON m.project_id=catalog.project_id AND m.asset_type=catalog.asset_type AND m.asset_id=catalog.id LEFT JOIN test_asset_category c ON c.id=m.category_id AND c.deleted=b'0'
ORDER BY catalog.update_time DESC, catalog.id LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM () catalog LEFT JOIN test_asset_version v ON v.id = ( SELECT iv.id FROM test_asset_version iv WHERE iv.project_id = catalog.project_id AND iv.asset_type = catalog.asset_type AND iv.asset_id = catalog.id AND iv.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY iv.version_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN test_asset_metadata m ON m.project_id=catalog.project_id AND m.asset_type=catalog.asset_type AND m.asset_id=catalog.id LEFT JOIN test_asset_category c ON c.id=m.category_id AND c.deleted=b'0'

SELECT catalog.id, catalog.project_id AS projectId, catalog.asset_type AS assetType, catalog.name, catalog.category, catalog.status, catalog.summary, catalog.owner, catalog.update_time AS updateTime, catalog.source_version AS sourceVersion, catalog.related_id AS relatedId, v.id AS assetVersionId, v.version_no AS assetVersionNo, v.content_hash AS contentHash, COALESCE(m.creation_source,'UNKNOWN') AS creationSource,m.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName,c.path AS categoryPath,m.source_reference_type AS sourceReferenceType, m.source_reference_id AS sourceReferenceId FROM () catalog LEFT JOIN test_asset_version v ON v.id = ( SELECT iv.id FROM test_asset_version iv WHERE iv.project_id = catalog.project_id AND iv.asset_type = catalog.asset_type AND iv.asset_id = catalog.id AND iv.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY iv.version_no DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN test_asset_metadata m ON m.project_id=catalog.project_id AND m.asset_type=catalog.asset_type AND m.asset_id=catalog.id LEFT JOIN test_asset_category c ON c.id=m.category_id AND c.deleted=b'0' WHERE catalog.asset_type = #{assetType} AND catalog.id = #{assetId} LIMIT 1

choose.when: SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',f.id,'refId',f.ref_id,'name',f.name,'editType',f.case_edit_type,'tags',CAST(f.tags AS CHAR), 'steps',CAST(b.steps AS CHAR),'textDescription',CAST(b.text_description AS CHAR),'expectedResult',CAST(b.expected_result AS CHAR)) AS rawContentJson FROM functional_case f LEFT JOIN functional_case_blob b ON b.id=f.id WHERE f.project_id=#{projectId} AND f.latest=1 AND f.deleted=0 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(f.ref_id,''),f.id)=#{assetId} LIMIT 1

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',d.id,'name',d.original_name,'mimeType',d.mime_type,'sha256',d.sha256,'parseStatus',d.parse_status, 'summary',d.summary,'sectionIndex',d.section_index) AS rawContentJson FROM ai_source_document d WHERE d.project_id=#{projectId} AND d.id=#{assetId} AND d.deleted=0 LIMIT 1

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',p.id,'name',p.name,'status',p.status,'tags',p.tags,'description',p.description, 'plannedStartTime',p.planned_start_time,'plannedEndTime',p.planned_end_time) AS rawContentJson FROM test_plan p WHERE p.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.id=#{assetId} AND p.type='testPlan' LIMIT 1

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',p.id,'name',p.name,'routePattern',p.route_pattern,'allowedOrigins',p.allowed_origins,'status',p.status,'version',p.version, 'elements',(SELECT COALESCE(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id',e.id,'name',e.name,'strategy',e.strategy,'selectorValue',e.selector_value,'fallbackLocators',e.fallback_locators,'sensitive',e.`sensitive`,'riskLevel',e.risk_level,'version',e.version)),JSON_ARRAY()) FROM ai_page_element e WHERE e.page_object_id=p.id)) AS rawContentJson FROM ai_page_object p WHERE p.project_id=#{projectId} AND p.id=#{assetId} LIMIT 1

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id',b.id,'name',b.name,'nodes',b.nodes_json,'edges',b.edges_json,'entryNodeId',b.entry_node_id, 'exitConditions',b.exit_conditions,'allowedActions',b.allowed_actions,'status',b.status,'version',b.version) AS rawContentJson FROM ai_business_flow b WHERE b.project_id=#{projectId} AND b.id=#{assetId} LIMIT 1

SELECT f.id AS fileId, COALESCE(NULLIF(f.original_name, ''), f.name) AS fileName, f.type AS fileType, f.size AS fileSize, f.storage, f.path AS filePath, f.module_id AS moduleId, CAST(f.tags AS CHAR) AS tagsJson FROM file_metadata f WHERE f.project_id = #{projectId} AND f.latest = 1 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(f.ref_id, ''), f.id) = #{assetId} LIMIT 1
SELECT eb.config AS environmentConfig FROM environment e LEFT JOIN environment_blob eb ON eb.id = e.id WHERE e.project_id = #{projectId} AND e.id = #{assetId} LIMIT 1

SELECT cb.params AS commonParams, cb.script AS commonScript, cb.result AS commonResult, CAST(c.tags AS CHAR) AS tagsJson FROM custom_function c LEFT JOIN custom_function_blob cb ON cb.id = c.id WHERE c.project_id = #{projectId} AND c.id = #{assetId} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.protocol, a.method AS httpMethod, a.path AS apiPath, a.module_id AS moduleId, CAST(a.tags AS CHAR) AS tagsJson, ab.request AS apiRequest, ab.response AS apiResponse FROM api_definition a LEFT JOIN api_definition_blob ab ON ab.id = a.id WHERE a.project_id = #{projectId} AND a.latest = 1 AND a.deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(a.ref_id, ''), a.id) = #{assetId} LIMIT 1

SELECT ar.task_id AS taskId, ar.execution_case_id AS executionCaseId, ar.case_id AS caseId, ar.step_id AS stepId, ar.purpose, ar.content_type AS contentType, ar.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, ar.sha256, ar.redacted, ar.retention_until AS retentionUntil, ar.file_name AS fileName FROM ai_execution_artifact ar JOIN ai_execution_task t ON t.id = ar.task_id WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND ar.id = #{assetId} LIMIT 1

SELECT b.num AS bugNumber, bc.description AS bugDescription, b.handle_user AS handleUser, CAST(b.tags AS CHAR) AS tagsJson FROM bug b LEFT JOIN bug_content bc ON bc.bug_id = b.id WHERE b.project_id = #{projectId} AND b.deleted = 0 AND b.id = #{assetId} LIMIT 1

mapper.sql: COALESCE(d.original_name, fc.name, task.name, CONCAT('Step ', step_asset.pos, ': ', LEFT(step_asset.instruction, 120)), dataset.name, env.name, common_step.name, api_asset.name, evidence.file_name, bug_asset.title, v.asset_id)
mapper.select:
SELECT d.id, d.project_id AS projectId, d.original_name AS originalName, d.mime_type AS mimeType, d.file_size AS fileSize, d.sha256, d.duplicate, d.parse_status AS parseStatus, d.parser_type AS parserType, d.summary, d.error_message AS errorMessage, d.create_user AS createUser, d.create_time AS createTime, d.update_time AS updateTime, v.id AS assetVersionId, v.version_no AS assetVersionNo, COALESCE(dm.creation_source,'UNKNOWN') AS creationSource,dm.category_id AS categoryId, dc.name AS categoryName,dc.path AS categoryPath FROM ai_source_document d LEFT JOIN test_asset_metadata dm ON dm.project_id=d.project_id AND dm.asset_type='DOCUMENT' AND dm.asset_id=d.id LEFT JOIN test_asset_category dc ON dc.id=dm.category_id AND dc.deleted=b'0' LEFT JOIN test_asset_version v ON v.id = ( SELECT iv.id FROM test_asset_version iv WHERE iv.project_id = d.project_id AND iv.asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND iv.asset_id = d.id ORDER BY iv.version_no DESC LIMIT 1 )
ORDER BY d.update_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_source_document d LEFT JOIN test_asset_metadata dm ON dm.project_id=d.project_id AND dm.asset_type='DOCUMENT' AND dm.asset_id=d.id LEFT JOIN test_asset_category dc ON dc.id=dm.category_id AND dc.deleted=b'0'
mapper.sql: FROM test_asset_version v LEFT JOIN test_asset_metadata vm ON vm.project_id=v.project_id AND vm.asset_type=v.asset_type AND vm.asset_id=v.asset_id LEFT JOIN test_asset_category vc ON vc.id=vm.category_id AND vc.deleted=b'0' LEFT JOIN ai_source_document d ON v.asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND d.id = v.asset_id AND d.project_id = v.project_id LEFT JOIN functional_case fc ON v.asset_type = 'CASE' AND fc.ref_id = v.asset_id AND fc.project_id = v.project_id AND fc.latest = 1 AND fc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_task task ON v.asset_type = 'TASK' AND task.id = v.asset_id AND task.project_id = v.project_id LEFT JOIN ai_execution_step step_asset ON v.asset_type = 'STEP' AND step_asset.id = v.asset_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_execution_task step_task WHERE step_task.id = step_asset.task_id AND step_task.project_id = v.project_id) LEFT JOIN file_metadata dataset ON v.asset_type = 'DATASET' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(dataset.ref_id, ''), dataset.id) = v.asset_id AND dataset.project_id = v.project_id AND dataset.latest = 1 LEFT JOIN environment env ON v.asset_type = 'ENVIRONMENT' AND env.id = v.asset_id AND env.project_id = v.project_id LEFT JOIN custom_function common_step ON v.asset_type = 'COMMON_STEP' AND common_step.id = v.asset_id AND common_step.project_id = v.project_id LEFT JOIN api_definition api_asset ON v.asset_type = 'API_DEFINITION' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(api_asset.ref_id, ''), api_asset.id) = v.asset_id AND api_asset.project_id = v.project_id AND api_asset.latest = 1 AND api_asset.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_artifact evidence ON v.asset_type = 'EVIDENCE' AND evidence.id = v.asset_id LEFT JOIN bug bug_asset ON v.asset_type = 'BUG' AND bug_asset.id = v.asset_id AND bug_asset.project_id = v.project_id
mapper.select:
SELECT v.id, v.project_id AS projectId, v.asset_type AS assetType, v.asset_id AS assetId, AS assetName, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.source_version AS sourceVersion, v.content_hash AS contentHash, v.status, v.created_by AS createdBy, v.created_at AS createdAt, v.published_by AS publishedBy, v.published_at AS publishedAt, COALESCE(vm.creation_source,'UNKNOWN') AS creationSource,vm.category_id AS categoryId, vc.name AS categoryName,vc.path AS categoryPath
ORDER BY v.published_at DESC, v.version_no DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.sql:
WHERE r.project_id = #{projectId} AND r.source_asset_type IN
#{allowedType}
AND r.target_asset_type IN
#{allowedType}
AND (r.source_asset_type = #{assetType} OR r.target_asset_type = #{assetType})
AND (r.source_asset_id = #{assetId} OR r.target_asset_id = #{assetId})
AND r.relation_type = #{relationType}
AND (COALESCE(sm.creation_source,'UNKNOWN') IN #{source} OR COALESCE(tm.creation_source,'UNKNOWN') IN #{source})
AND (sm.category_id=#{categoryId} OR tm.category_id=#{categoryId})
AND (sc.id=#{categoryId} OR tc.id=#{categoryId} OR sc.path LIKE CONCAT((SELECT path FROM test_asset_category WHERE id=#{categoryId} AND deleted=b'0'),' / %') OR tc.path LIKE CONCAT((SELECT path FROM test_asset_category WHERE id=#{categoryId} AND deleted=b'0'),' / %'))
AND (LOWER(r.source_asset_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(r.target_asset_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(sd.original_name, sfc.name, st.name, CONCAT('Step ', ss.pos, ': ', LEFT(ss.instruction, 120)), CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(sv.content_snapshot) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sv.content_snapshot, '$.name')) END, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(td.original_name, tfc.name, tt.name, CONCAT('Step ', ts.pos, ': ', LEFT(ts.instruction, 120)), CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(tv.content_snapshot) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tv.content_snapshot, '$.name')) END, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%'))
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.project_id AS projectId, r.relation_type AS relationType, r.source_asset_type AS sourceAssetType, r.source_asset_id AS sourceAssetId, COALESCE(sd.original_name, sfc.name, st.name, CONCAT('Step ', ss.pos, ': ', LEFT(ss.instruction, 120)), CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(sv.content_snapshot) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(sv.content_snapshot, '$.name')) END, r.source_asset_id) AS sourceAssetName, r.source_version_id AS sourceVersionId, sv.version_no AS sourceVersionNo, r.target_asset_type AS targetAssetType, r.target_asset_id AS targetAssetId, COALESCE(td.original_name, tfc.name, tt.name, CONCAT('Step ', ts.pos, ': ', LEFT(ts.instruction, 120)), CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(tv.content_snapshot) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(tv.content_snapshot, '$.name')) END, r.target_asset_id) AS targetAssetName, r.target_version_id AS targetVersionId, tv.version_no AS targetVersionNo, r.metadata, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE(sm.creation_source,'UNKNOWN') AS sourceCreationSource,sc.path AS sourceCategoryPath, COALESCE(tm.creation_source,'UNKNOWN') AS targetCreationSource,tc.path AS targetCategoryPath FROM test_asset_relation r LEFT JOIN test_asset_metadata sm ON sm.project_id=r.project_id AND sm.asset_type=r.source_asset_type AND sm.asset_id=r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN test_asset_category sc ON sc.id=sm.category_id AND sc.deleted=b'0' LEFT JOIN test_asset_metadata tm ON tm.project_id=r.project_id AND tm.asset_type=r.target_asset_type AND tm.asset_id=r.target_asset_id LEFT JOIN test_asset_category tc ON tc.id=tm.category_id AND tc.deleted=b'0' LEFT JOIN test_asset_version sv ON sv.id = r.source_version_id LEFT JOIN test_asset_version tv ON tv.id = r.target_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_source_document sd ON r.source_asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND sd.id = r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN functional_case sfc ON r.source_asset_type = 'CASE' AND sfc.ref_id = r.source_asset_id AND sfc.latest = 1 AND sfc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_task st ON r.source_asset_type = 'TASK' AND st.id = r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN ai_execution_step ss ON r.source_asset_type = 'STEP' AND ss.id = r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN ai_source_document td ON r.target_asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND td.id = r.target_asset_id LEFT JOIN functional_case tfc ON r.target_asset_type = 'CASE' AND tfc.ref_id = r.target_asset_id AND tfc.latest = 1 AND tfc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_task tt ON r.target_asset_type = 'TASK' AND tt.id = r.target_asset_id LEFT JOIN ai_execution_step ts ON r.target_asset_type = 'STEP' AND ts.id = r.target_asset_id
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM test_asset_relation r LEFT JOIN test_asset_metadata sm ON sm.project_id=r.project_id AND sm.asset_type=r.source_asset_type AND sm.asset_id=r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN test_asset_category sc ON sc.id=sm.category_id AND sc.deleted=b'0' LEFT JOIN test_asset_metadata tm ON tm.project_id=r.project_id AND tm.asset_type=r.target_asset_type AND tm.asset_id=r.target_asset_id LEFT JOIN test_asset_category tc ON tc.id=tm.category_id AND tc.deleted=b'0' LEFT JOIN test_asset_version sv ON sv.id = r.source_version_id LEFT JOIN test_asset_version tv ON tv.id = r.target_version_id LEFT JOIN ai_source_document sd ON r.source_asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND sd.id = r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN functional_case sfc ON r.source_asset_type = 'CASE' AND sfc.ref_id = r.source_asset_id AND sfc.latest = 1 AND sfc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_task st ON r.source_asset_type = 'TASK' AND st.id = r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN ai_execution_step ss ON r.source_asset_type = 'STEP' AND ss.id = r.source_asset_id LEFT JOIN ai_source_document td ON r.target_asset_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND td.id = r.target_asset_id LEFT JOIN functional_case tfc ON r.target_asset_type = 'CASE' AND tfc.ref_id = r.target_asset_id AND tfc.latest = 1 AND tfc.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ai_execution_task tt ON r.target_asset_type = 'TASK' AND tt.id = r.target_asset_id LEFT JOIN ai_execution_step ts ON r.target_asset_type = 'STEP' AND ts.id = r.target_asset_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_asset_version (id, project_id, asset_type, asset_id, version_no, source_version, content_hash, content_snapshot, status, created_by, created_at, published_by, published_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{assetType}, #{assetId}, #{versionNo}, #{sourceVersion}, #{contentHash}, #{contentSnapshot}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{publishedBy}, #{publishedAt})

INSERT IGNORE INTO test_asset_relation (id, project_id, relation_type, source_asset_type, source_asset_id, source_version_id, target_asset_type, target_asset_id, target_version_id, metadata, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{projectId}, #{relationType}, #{sourceAssetType}, #{sourceAssetId}, COALESCE(#{sourceVersionId}, ''), #{targetAssetType}, #{targetAssetId}, COALESCE(#{targetVersionId}, ''), #{metadata}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
